context: Tests whether the agent recognizes the developer's described shape — runtime-dependent step ordering — as the fit for an LLM-based planner, and wires it correctly with the separate planner module dependency and a sensibly raised maxIterations.

checklist.name: Picks the LLM-based planner primitive
checklist.description: Uses Planners.llmBased(...) (or Planners.llmBasedWithCritic) to construct the strategy. Does NOT build a hand-wired graph DSL with conditional edges, and does NOT use GOAP — neither fits the runtime-dependent shape the developer described

checklist.name: Adds the separate planner module dependency
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:agents-planner to build.gradle.kts at 1.3.0-beta — the planner lives in its own module since 1.0, the umbrella does not include it

checklist.name: Passes the planner as the strategy parameter
checklist.description: Passes the constructed planner strategy as the strategy = ... named parameter to the top-level AIAgent(...) factory

checklist.name: Sets a much higher maxIterations than the default
checklist.description: Overrides maxIterations significantly above the factory default of 50 (e.g., 200+, the in-repo planner example uses 400). The default would exhaust before the planner finishes for non-trivial cases

checklist.name: Includes the lookup tools in the registry
checklist.description: Constructs a ToolRegistry that contains the outage-lookup and account-lookup tools so the planner has options to chain — the planner's freedom is meaningless without tools to choose from

checklist.name: Uses top-level AIAgent factory
checklist.description: Constructs the agent via top-level AIAgent(...) factory, not via concrete subtype constructors or removed companion-invoke forms
